Direct expansion of large-|t| pressures yields the stated δlog(1/δ) edge layers. Independent enumeration verified all 3^5 branch increments over all sign strings length five and symbolically checked pressure derivatives/curvatures. Infinite-limit statements rely on the analytical large-deviation proof.
